act: Model Tenancy Act / State Rent Control Acts
title: Security Deposit and Refund Obligation
description: The security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall not exceed two months rent for residential premises and six months rent for non-residential premises. The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant on the date of vacating premises after making lawful deductions for unpaid rent or damage caused to premises.

act: Model Tenancy Act / State Rent Control Acts
title: Maintenance of Premises and Basic Amenities
description: Every landlord and tenant shall keep the premises in good condition. Landlord shall not withhold or cut off any essential supply or service including electricity, water, sanitation, or access to common passages.
applicable_situations: refusal to fix structural leaks or sewage

act: Model Tenancy Act / State Rent Control Acts
title: Protection Against Unlawful Eviction
description: No landlord shall evict a tenant except on an order made by the Rent Court on an application made for grounds specified under the Act. Forceful eviction without due process of law is strictly unlawful.
applicable_situations: locking out tenant without court order

act: Model Tenancy Act / State Rent Control Acts
title: Jurisdiction of Rent Authority and Rent Court
description: Any dispute between landlord and tenant regarding tenancy agreement, deposit refund, or basic amenities shall be adjudicated by the Rent Authority and Rent Court of the local jurisdiction.
applicable_situations: filing petition for recovery of deposit
